name: Data.exists_mul_endPeriod_mem_embValRing
summary: From the branching data take N = (∏_τ (g^{b₁}N₁)^{m|L(τ)|})·ν^{2m}; by `Data.endPeriod_mem` the end period is a sum of short sums of values N·pairing of p-integral chain vectors, each p-integral; the size bound by the log bounds.

steps.claim: The branching data of the end pairing (L, B, C) (`Data.endBranching`).
steps.lean:
D.endBranching.2.1.elim fun L ⟨B, C, _⟩ ↦ by
  choose a b c using boxes_endWeightData_le
  use (∏ τ, (D.gProd ^ D.b₁ * D.N₁) ^ (D.m * (L τ).natAbs)) * (?ν ^ D.m) ^ 2, ?_, le_exp_of_log_le
    ?_, fun h hy q k ↦ (embValRing.toAddSubgroup.comap (.mulLeft _)).nsmul_subset .rfl
    (endPeriod_mem h hy (fun z j g v ↦ weylGauge _ (D.endDetExp z j) g (((?ν : ℂ) • ·)^[j] v) ≤ 1)
    ιₚ (fun _ _ _ j g h v ↦ .trans (by
    simpa [endKernel] using P.mem_raises_of_dvd (endDatum ..)
      (P.smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus (by
    simp [ite_mem]) q) embValRing.one_mem (by grw [card_prod, b, a, a]; use 1; exacts
              [j.le, j, j]) g h ((_ : ℂ) • v))) k fun {g _ _} a b ↦ ?_).choose_spec.2
  iterate 2 simp [log_prod, log_mul, NeZero.ne, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, -Nat.cast_natAbs]
  grw [C, b, c] <;> simp; simpa using D.le_of_hasLogBound
  erw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc, Nat.cast_pow, sq, ← smul_eq_mul (_ * _), mul_smul, ← map_smul,
    ← D.endPairing.map_smul₂, map_mul, ιₚ.map_dotProduct, Nat.cast_pow]
  simp only [map_natCast, comp_def, ιₚ.map_mulVec, smul_iterate, mulVecLin_apply, weylGauge,
    ← map_inv, Matrix.map_map, map_intCast, endBlockPoint,
    pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg one_pos.le] at a b ⊢
  rw [← (Units.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul _).2 (B _ _ _ g⁻¹ ..), ← mul_assoc, Nat.cast_prod,
    ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib, Units.coe_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine NormedField.valuation.integer.mul_mem (prod_mem fun τ _ ↦ ?_) (sum_mem fun _ _ ↦
    mul_mem (a _) (sum_mem fun _ _ ↦ mul_mem (by simp) (b _)))
  obtain ⟨u, n, e | e⟩ := mul_mem (((gridModulus ‹_›).generator_spec.2.2 _).1
    ((Modulus.reduction_eq_zero_iff _).2 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus)))
    (mul_mem (star_mem_Ô (mul_mem (Modulus.generator_spec _).1
    P.N₁_mul_α_mem)) P.inv_α_mem), (L τ).eq_nat_or_neg <;> [skip; apply star_mem_Ô at u] <;>
    use (norm_adeleExtension_le_one ((ιₚ.comp _).comp _) (pow_mem u (D.m * n))).trans_eq'
    (by simp [Modulus.flipScalar, e, scalarFin, coe_divStar, WeilData.α, ← inv_pow,
    adeleExtension_star, q.norm_natCast_eq_one, -Nat.cast_prod]; ring)

steps.claim: The size bounds of `Data.boxes_endWeightData_le` (a, b, c).
steps.lean: choose a b c using boxes_endWeightData_le

steps.claim: Take N = (∏_τ (g^{b₁}N₁)^{m|L(τ)|})·(ν^m)², with ν a constant left open; N ≠ 0 and N ≤ exp(x⁹⁹b²) (left as goals); for the integrality apply `Data.endPeriod_mem` with the predicate "Weyl gauge ≤ 1 after ν^j-scaling" and the kernels raising integrality by the divisibility of the data (`Parameters.mem_raises_of_dvd`, `Parameters.smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData`), the sum being a multiple of the set of p-integral pairings.
steps.lean:
use (∏ τ, (D.gProd ^ D.b₁ * D.N₁) ^ (D.m * (L τ).natAbs)) * (?ν ^ D.m) ^ 2, ?_, le_exp_of_log_le
    ?_, fun h hy q k ↦ (embValRing.toAddSubgroup.comap (.mulLeft _)).nsmul_subset .rfl
    (endPeriod_mem h hy (fun z j g v ↦ weylGauge _ (D.endDetExp z j) g (((?ν : ℂ) • ·)^[j] v) ≤ 1)
    ιₚ (fun _ _ _ j g h v ↦ .trans (by
    simpa [endKernel] using P.mem_raises_of_dvd (endDatum ..)
      (P.smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus (by
    simp [ite_mem]) q) embValRing.one_mem (by grw [card_prod, b, a, a]; use 1; exacts
              [j.le, j, j]) g h ((_ : ℂ) • v))) k fun {g _ _} a b ↦ ?_).choose_spec.2

steps.claim: The logarithm of N (products and powers).
The size bound from C and the box bounds (`Data.le_of_hasLogBound`).
steps.lean: grw [C, b, c] <;> simp; simpa using D.le_of_hasLogBound

steps.claim: The pairing of scaled vectors: pull the scalars N out of the bilinear end pairing and map by the p-adic embedding ιₚ.
steps.lean:
erw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc, Nat.cast_pow, sq, ← smul_eq_mul (_ * _), mul_smul, ← map_smul,
    ← D.endPairing.map_smul₂, map_mul, ιₚ.map_dotProduct, Nat.cast_pow]

steps.claim: Read the Weyl gauges coordinatewise (norms ≤ 1 after the inverse scaling).
steps.lean:
simp only [map_natCast, comp_def, ιₚ.map_mulVec, smul_iterate, mulVecLin_apply, weylGauge,
    ← map_inv, Matrix.map_map, map_intCast, endBlockPoint,
    pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg one_pos.le] at a b ⊢

steps.claim: Move the branching matrix through the weight representations (B) and collect the units.
steps.lean:
rw [← (Units.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul _).2 (B _ _ _ g⁻¹ ..), ← mul_assoc, Nat.cast_prod,
    ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib, Units.coe_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

steps.claim: Integrality: a product of integral factors times a sum of products of integral entries (the valuation ring is closed under these).
steps.lean:
refine NormedField.valuation.integer.mul_mem (prod_mem fun τ _ ↦ ?_) (sum_mem fun _ _ ↦
    mul_mem (a _) (sum_mem fun _ _ ↦ mul_mem (by simp) (b _)))

steps.claim: The integral factors at τ: the generator of the modulus divides g^{b₁}N₁ (`Modulus.generator_spec`), and depending on the sign of L(τ) the conjugate is integral too; their norm is at most 1 (`norm_adeleExtension_le_one`).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨u, n, e | e⟩ := mul_mem (((gridModulus ‹_›).generator_spec.2.2 _).1
    ((Modulus.reduction_eq_zero_iff _).2 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus)))
    (mul_mem (star_mem_Ô (mul_mem (Modulus.generator_spec _).1
    P.N₁_mul_α_mem)) P.inv_α_mem), (L τ).eq_nat_or_neg <;> [skip; apply star_mem_Ô at u] <;>
    use (norm_adeleExtension_le_one ((ιₚ.comp _).comp _) (pow_mem u (D.m * n))).trans_eq'
    (by simp [Modulus.flipScalar, e, scalarFin, coe_divStar, WeilData.α, ← inv_pow,
    adeleExtension_star, q.norm_natCast_eq_one, -Nat.cast_prod]; ring)
